name: Production PTU deployment with three-way approval, quota failure and .retry
description: A 100-PTU GlobalProvisionedManaged gpt-4.1 deployment on the production Foundry resource. Policy adds the AI-governance and FinOps escalations on top of the platform-ai base rule. The first execution fails the pre-flight quota check; after the platform team raises PTU quota, an approver comments `.retry`, the gate re-verifies approvals for the unchanged digest, and the deployment succeeds.

issue.title: [IssueOps] Foundry deployment: gpt-4.1 PTU for agents (prod)

values.foundry_use_case: Production backing model for the AKS agent runner (agentic-task-request, aks-foundry-agent backend) and the incident-summary agent. Predictable latency is required during incident response, so provisioned throughput is requested.

selected: Only data classified Internal or lower will be sent to this deployment unless it is approved for Confidential data
I understand provisioned (PTU) deployments are billed hourly whether or not they are used

steps.body: .approve Internal data only until the DPIA is signed.
steps.note: sec-sofia holds the security_manager organization role, which satisfies the AI-governance rule.
The requestor cannot retry: `.retry` is an approver command.

steps.body: .retry PTU quota raised to 500 in eastus2 (support case 2609210040).
